custom_terms_review_notes: Sketchfab NoAI bars use with programs designed to generate new content; CreatedWithAI is the separate creation label. The present B1 ACT/Diffusion policies output robot actions, not generated media or 3D content, so NoAI alone does not establish a conflict for this limited use. This review does not authorize generative-content training or broader reuse.
duplicate_review_notes: The source UID and visible two-panel wood door with black lever differ from the two prepared candidates. No local geometry fingerprint has been generated.
